doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Starting piano at nine and leaving a Missouri farm for New York
summary: Sutton began piano at nine, studied through school, and joined Teagarden at 19, finding New York a shock.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, I started out when I was nine years old.

Studying piano through grade school, high school, and part college. I was in college when I joined Jack Teagarden when I was 19. I went from a Missouri farm boy to New York City, it scared me to death.
Was that culture shock or what?
I don’t know. It was a shock, I don’t know how much culture was involved. So that’s how I got to know Jack.
